profile.headline: Software Engineer @Google
profile.summary: I'm a self-taught Software Engineer, born out of Kansas City. I spend most of my free time teaching myself new talents, programming languages and refining old concepts. I take pride in my passion for Software Engineering- which has led me to dabble in just about every mainstream language. However, I'll always utilize the languages and skills that best suit the occasion and project. This passion for development and the creation of new applications is what keeps me pushing forward and teaching myself more about the inner workings of Software Engineering every day.

honors.title: Excellence Award
honors.description: For exemplary work in Mobile Applications Development

volunteerExperiences.description:
Actively assisted students with any and all CS related work, bettering their knowledge of the given concepts.
Topics include, but not limited to: Object Orientated Programming, Syntaxial differences, Usage of MVC, Version Control Systems, Data Structures/Algorithms, REST API Usage, and common practices in various languages.
Assisted students in their learning of the basic-advanced concepts of Software Development. Spent a lot of time teaching students usage in C#, Java, Lua, and Python.

projects.title: kHTML
projects.description: Lightweight HTML5 DSL written in pure Kotlin. Write 1:1 HTML elements as Kotlin objects, and compile them to clean HTML5 markdown with properties.

projects.title: dChat
projects.description: Desktop messaging platform developed and designed completely in Kotlin. Fully complete backend service, with end-to-end documentation and business layer testing.
